findings.finding: GetResult delegates to ValidateEnd; fast successful completion omits slow handling. Slow HandleNonSuccess invokes InternalWait only if incomplete, then debugger/exception work. Any of these managed frames may be an ancestor to another frame and is not proof of blocking at sample time.

Task wait context can include completion checks, optional inlining, spin and blocking paths. A named InternalWait/SpinThenBlockingWait frame does not establish physical blocking, scheduler delay or useful task progress.

ManualResetEventSlim Wait tests IsSet and zero timeout; SemaphoreSlim WaitAsync can return already completed true/false Tasks. Entrypoint presence is not duration or a physically blocked thread. Async waiting need not block the executing thread.

InitializeArray copies data and checks arguments; PrepareMethod/Delegate and RunClassConstructor forward preparation/constructor operations. Presence of a named preparation/loading frame cannot establish native JIT execution/CPU, cost, compilation progress or all child work.

Collect and WaitForPendingFinalizers are explicit request/join entrypoints. Their sampled presence does not bind GC suspension episodes, identify collection success or attribute a managed-thread pause.

Extractor walks managed CallStack then Caller with 4096 frame cap and marks truncation. Retain ordinal as serialized_frame_depth only; it is not a physical native leaf/top frame, on-CPU state or instruction-level execution proof. Missing/unresolved/trimmed frames limit negative claims.

findings.finding: PID/native headerTID equality and timestamp overlap select recorded context candidates. They do not establish native generation lifetime, permanent task ownership, direct callsite or causal dependencies. Retain all candidates/nested overlaps and strict boundaries.

ANY-frame labels are nonexclusive and may coexist through ancestors. Keep exact frame/rule/catalog/depth witnesses; report distinct raw point counts separately from globalquery/row associations. Do not add category counts into exclusive work proportions or convert point counts to elapsed/CPU/wait duration.
